hooks.command:
printf '
── VolunteersManager harness ──
Read CLAUDE.md and .harness/STATE.md before any work.
Current state:
' && head -16 .harness/STATE.md && printf '
Locked decisions: docs/milestones/README.md → "Locked decisions"
Run ./scripts/harness/check.sh before finishing.
──
'
./scripts/harness/check.sh --quiet || { echo; echo '⚠️  Harness check failed before stop. Fix the issues above before declaring done.'; exit 2; }
